text:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: recurring chain observed across recent incidents: cloud transient -> auth token surge -> model-registry timeouts -> brief user errors. Need a single remediation tracker, owners, and a monthly cadence. Who can take point? :mag:
aj: I can own the tracker and rotation. I'll create a sheet with owner, priority, status, SLA mapping. Can someone export 90 days of vendor-filtered incidents?
liam: I'll extract logs and produce a vendor-by-week heatmap (include deploy timestamps and time-of-day). ETA EOD.
sre_lead: Please add columns for failure-mode and short-term mitigation. Also audit circuit-breaker thresholds and autoscaler backoff; retries may be amplifying failures.
kate: I'll reconcile runbooks with observed failures and propose runbook patches (token jitter handling, cross-region retry). Draft by Tue AM.
security: I'll review KMS rotation windows and token TTLs. If rotations are synchronized, propose adding jitter to avoid auth spikes. Report by Monday.
aj: Action items - claim with :white_check_mark::
- AJ: remediation tracker (sheet + owners) due 2026-04-15
- LIAM: vendor heatmap + 90d extracts due 2026-04-13
- KATE: runbook gap doc + patches due 2026-04-14
- SECURITY: rotation review + jitter proposal due 2026-04-13
- SRE_LEAD: circuit-breaker & autoscaler review due 2026-04-16
- TEAM: propose monthly dependency failover drill (synthetic traffic) due 2026-04-20
liam: ack. Example commands I'll use: `journalctl -u svc-model-registry | grep -E \"(timeout|401|503)\" > /tmp/registry-errors.log` then run heatmap tool.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0413-07 linked; creating tracker item DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned AJ.
sre_lead: Short-term mitigation proposals:
1) Per-route fallback to a cached model snapshot (v1-small) when registry_latency_ms > 200 for short windows.
2) Synthetic canary every 12h to validate failover and surface drift to the console.
Prototype fallback rule for router config included in tracker.
kate: For the drill, propose a scoped \"auth-provider burst\" scenario to measure time-to-fallback, alert coverage, and user error delta. I'll draft the runbook.
security: Adding vendor-SLA mapping to the tracker so actions align with contract coverage.
aj: I'll create a recurring calendar item \"dependency resilience review\" and rotate owners monthly. Who volunteers for first rotation?
maria: Thanks. Please add postmortem link in the tracker, mark infra fallback work as blocker, and confirm sync next Wed 09:00 to review heatmap + tracker. Leaving thread open for updates through Monday. Tag @maria or @aj if blocked. :calendar: :eyes:
